description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 ne Rrugen Bardhok Biba, prane Qendres se Tiranes e shume prane rruges kryesore.
Ndodhet ne nje pallat egzistues ne katin e 5 te nje pallati 6-katesh. 
Prona organizohet nga 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 dhome ndenje + kuzhine, 1 tualet dhe ballkon. 
Disponon dokumentation te rregullt hipotekor. 
Kjo prone eshte e pershtatshme per banim por edhe per investim (qira apo airbnb) pasi zona eshte teper favorizuese.
Per me teper informacion, na kontaktoni!
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Bardhok Biba Street, near the Center of Tirana and very close to the main road. It is located in an existing building on the 5th floor of a 6-story building. The property is organized by 2 bedrooms, 1 living room + kitchen, 1 bathroom and balcony. Has regular mortgage documentation. This property is suitable for living but also for investment (rent or airbnb) as the area is very favorable. For more information, contact us!
